find: if ('cssRules' in rule) walk((rule as CSSGroupingRule).cssRules, focusState);
replace: // rules inside @media, @supports and nesting go unread
why: Stops the guard descending into rules that hold rules. hud.css wraps rules in `@media`; a focus-state `display` rule inside one, inside `@supports`, or nested under a focus-state rule would pass the install unseen.
killedBy: computed-style-cache: the focus-state guard reports display set under a rule inside @media
computed-style-cache: the focus-state guard reports display set under a rule inside @supports
computed-style-cache: the focus-state guard reports display set under a rule nested under a focus-state rule
